description: Show templates to the user as a visual carousel with their real thumbnails and playable previews. First get the data with list_featured_templates (or list_templates), then call this tool with the templates you want to present, copying id, name, thumbnail_url, video_url, width and height exactly as returned (1 to 12 templates). It shows the real thumbnails of JSON2Video templates. The carousel has a "Use this template" button, so you do not need to list the templates again in text.

thumbnail_url.description: Thumbnail image URL, as returned by list_featured_templates

video_url.description: Preview video (MP4) URL, as returned by list_featured_templates

name: show_templates
title: Show templates
